text: 金十数据8月19日讯，微博(09898.HK)发布2026年第二季度财报，微博二季度总营收4.538亿美元（约合人民币30.8亿元），其中广告营收3.81亿美元（约合人民币25.84亿元），二季度调整后运营利润1.254亿美元（约合人民币8.46亿元），调整后运营利润率达到28%。用户方面，截至二季度末，微博的月活跃用户达到5.61亿，日活跃用户达到2.54亿。
text_en: Jin10 Data August 19 - Weibo (09898.HK) reported Q2 2026 revenue of $453.8 million (approx. 3.08 billion yuan), with advertising revenue of $381 million (approx. 2.584 billion yuan). Adjusted operating profit was $125.4 million (approx. 846 million yuan), with an adjusted operating margin of 28%. As of quarter-end, monthly active users reached 561 million and daily active users 254 million.
